content.title: About
content.content: The fruit flavored drink comes as a powder that is reconstituted with water. It is low‑calorie, sugar‑free, and uses artificial sweeteners and flavorings to mimic various fruit tastes. The powder is easy to store and transport, and once mixed it yields a refreshing beverage.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The powdered format preserves aroma longer than many ready‑to‑drink liquids.
Diet versions often use sucralose or stevia instead of sugar.
Most of these drinks contain vitamin C and sometimes B‑complex additives.
Portioning is simple: typically one sachet (≈10 g) per 250 ml of water.
In some countries they are classified as “food supplements” rather than beverages.

items.title: Low calorie
items.content: Absence of sugar makes the drink suitable for weight‑control diets.

items.title: Rapid hydration
items.content: Reconstitution with water provides quick fluid intake.

items.title: Vitamin boost
items.content: Certain variants are fortified with vitamin C and other micronutrients.

items.title: Convenient storage
items.content: The powder does not require refrigeration and has a long shelf life.

items.title: Electrolyte support
items.content: Formulations often contain small amounts of sodium and potassium.

items.title: Artificial sweeteners
items.content: Some individuals may experience gastrointestinal discomfort.

items.title: Allergens
items.content: Flavorings may contain trace fruit allergens.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: People with hypertension should monitor their sodium intake.

items.title: Not a meal replacement
items.content: The drink lacks protein, fat, and fiber needed for a balanced diet.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Mix one sachet of powder with 250 ml of cold water, stir thoroughly until fully dissolved. For extra flavor, add a slice of lemon or a sprig of mint.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep sachets in a dry, cool place away from direct sunlight. After opening, reseal tightly to prevent moisture ingress.
